ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity white/cream central regions versus 35% low-intensity black/dark-gray peripheral and trailing edge regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white field across both lobes. Trailing edge is bordered by a non-uniform dark gray band ranging from 15-50 pixels in width. Left lobe features four distinct circular low-intensity spots (~15 pixel diameter) in a trapezoidal cluster. Right lobe exhibits fine-grained dark mottling and three distinct circular spots near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped indentation; interior angle approximately 48 degrees with a depth reaching ~15% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serration profile. Left lobe trailing edge displays 9 primary jagged peaks. Right lobe trailing edge displays a higher frequency of smaller-amplitude peaks (approx. 14) creating a ragged, saw-tooth texture.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the outer margins leading toward the distal tips; slight convex bulge localized near the transition from the peduncle to the inner lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clustered high-texture, tan/brown pixel groups localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Multiple isolated circular dark pixel clusters (8-12 pixels wide) distributed across the white ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Five faint, parallel vertical gray lines (approx. 40-60 pixels in length) visible on the lower quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of raised, irregular calcified textures on the terminal tips of both lobes. Notable deep notch on the left lobe trailing edge near the 1/3 distal point.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized patches of low-saturation yellow/tan pixel staining visible in the lower central regions of both lobes.
